entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with David at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'd like to start a return for an order I received last month.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-0125. It was for a cycling helmet.
Got it, thank you. I see the order was delivered 33 days ago. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's a preference, I suppose. The online color, 'Crimson Flash', looked like a deep red, but in person, it's almost a neon orange. It's not what I was expecting at all. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out.

I understand completely. Sometimes the lighting in photos can alter the shade. Let me just pull up our current return policy for you... Okay, I see here that since the item was delivered within the last 90 days, you are eligible for a full refund. As long as the product is in its original condition, of course.

That's good to hear. It's definitely in original condition. Now, since I have to go through the trouble of shipping it back because the color wasn't accurately represented, would you be able to offer a small discount code for my next purchase? I still need a helmet.

I appreciate you asking, and I'm glad you're planning to shop with us again. However, my system doesn't allow for discount codes on returns related to color preference. I can definitely get the return label sent to your email right away so you can get your refund processed quickly. The most important thing is that you find a helmet with the right color and perfect safety features for your needs.
Fair enough, I had to try. The quick approval is good enough for me. Please send the label.

Excellent. I've just sent that return authorization and shipping label to the email on file. Just to confirm for our records, since the box is unopened, the helmet's protective and safety integrity is completely intact, correct?
Yes, that is correct. It's brand new.
Perfect. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see the refund back to your original payment method in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
